claim_ledger.claim: ROY as presently expressed is a validated quantitative metric.
claim_ledger.evidence: Definitions vary; no validation found; tutorial labels heuristic.

claim_ledger.next_check: Use heuristic definition and separate measurable outcomes/costs.

claim_ledger.evidence: No controlled comparator or measured reader outcome.
